scripts.publish: npm run build:css && dotnet publish CvHub/CvHub.csproj -c Release -o publish --nologo
scripts.deploy: npm run publish && rsync -av --exclude='appsettings*' --exclude='*.pdb' --exclude='.env*' --rsync-path="sudo rsync" --chown=ubuntu:ubuntu publish/ oracle:/home/ubuntu/cvhub/ && ssh oracle "sudo systemctl restart cvhub && sleep 10"
scripts.deploy:verify: for p in / /positions /Account/Login; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p=%{http_code}\n" http://cvms.tangent.website$p; done
